where.if: AND (c.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR c.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.category, c.subject, c.lesson_mode AS lessonMode, c.campus_scope AS campusScope, c.campus_id AS campusId, CASE WHEN c.campus_scope = '全部' THEN '全部校区' ELSE COALESCE(cp.name, '—') END AS campusName, CASE WHEN c.campus_scope = '全部' THEN camp.campusTotal ELSE 1 END AS campusCount, CONCAT_WS('、', IF(c.lesson_charge = 1, '按课时', NULL), IF(c.time_charge = 1, '按时间', NULL), IF(c.period_charge = 1, '按期', NULL)) AS chargeMode, COALESCE(e.studentCount, 0) AS studentCount, COALESCE(e.activeStudentCount, 0) AS activeStudentCount, COALESCE(e.buyLessons, 0) AS buyLessons, COALESCE(e.usedLessons, 0) AS usedLessons, COALESCE(e.remainLessons, 0) AS remainLessons, COALESCE(e.paidAmount, 0) AS paidAmount, COALESCE(e.debt, 0) + c.report_debt AS debt, COALESCE(cg.classCount, 0) AS classCount, COALESCE(sc.scheduleCount, 0) AS scheduleCount, sc.lastLessonDate AS lastLessonDate, c.material_fee AS materialFee, c.created_at AS createdAt, c.status, c.remark FROM course c LEFT JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS campusTotal FROM campus) camp ON 1 = 1 LEFT JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = c.campus_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS studentCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status = '生效' THEN student_id END) AS activeStudentCount, SUM(total_lessons + gift_lessons) AS buyLessons, SUM(used_lessons) AS usedLessons, SUM(remain_lessons) AS remainLessons, SUM(paid_amount) AS paidAmount, 0 AS debt FROM enrollment GROUP BY course_id ) e ON e.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS classCount FROM class_group WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY course_id ) cg ON cg.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(*) AS scheduleCount, MAX(lesson_date) AS lastLessonDate FROM schedule WHERE course_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY course_id ) sc ON sc.course_id = c.id

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(c.status = 1), 0) AS active, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM class_group g WHERE g.course_id = c.id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS opening, COALESCE(SUM(e.studentCount), 0) AS enrollCount, COALESCE(SUM(e.remainLessons), 0) AS remainLessons, COALESCE(SUM(e.paidAmount), 0) AS paidAmount, COALESCE(SUM(c.report_debt), 0) AS debt FROM course c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(DISTINCT student_id) AS studentCount, SUM(remain_lessons) AS remainLessons, SUM(paid_amount) AS paidAmount FROM enrollment GROUP BY course_id ) e ON e.course_id = c.id

SELECT cc.id, cc.name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course c WHERE c.category = cc.name) AS courseCount FROM course_category cc
AND cc.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY cc.id

SELECT u.id, u.name, u.from_course_id AS fromCourseId, f.name AS fromCourseName, u.to_course_id AS toCourseId, t.name AS toCourseName, u.period_count AS periodCount, CASE WHEN u.to_course_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS courseCount, u.created_at AS createdAt FROM course_upgrade u LEFT JOIN course f ON f.id = u.from_course_id LEFT JOIN course t ON t.id = u.to_course_id
AND u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
ORDER BY u.id DESC

SELECT p.id, p.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, p.lessons, p.total_price AS totalPrice FROM course_price p LEFT JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = p.campus_id WHERE p.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY p.id

SELECT g.id, g.name, g.teacher_text AS teacherName, g.status, g.enrolled_count AS enrolledCount, g.capacity, g.schedule_text AS scheduleText, g.start_date AS startDate FROM class_group g WHERE g.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY g.id DESC
